title: feat: update Gemini to 3.7 Flash
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Updates canonical `gemini` and its existing `gemini-3.6-flash` / `gemini-3.5-flash` aliases to `google/gemini-3.7-flash`.
- Pins OpenRouter to `google-vertex/global` with provider fallback disabled; no Pollinations fallback or GPU route.
- Applies the OpenRouter promotion: $0.375/M input, $0.0375/M cached input, $1.875/M output, $0.007/search, and exact five-minute cache-storage pricing.
- Keeps `paidOnly: true` and `priceMultiplier: 1`.

The promotional rates expire after August 27, 2026; the follow-up pricing update is ready in #13352.

Verified with direct OpenRouter probes and local Pollinations E2E for text, image, audio, video, tools, JSON, search, streaming, aliases, paid-only permissions, response/provider caching, errors, billing, and a five-request burst. Gen tests: 126 passed. Enter tests: 377 passed. Both typechecks pass.

gist.headline: Flash, freshly pollinated
gist.blurb: Gemini’s canonical route and its familiar Flash aliases now point to Gemini 3.7 Flash. Polli packed the fast new pollen into the same jars, so existing calls keep finding their way home.
gist.summary: Updated canonical `gemini` plus the `gemini-3.6-flash` and `gemini-3.5-flash` aliases to `google/gemini-3.7-flash` on OpenRouter’s `google-vertex/global` provider, with provider fallback disabled and promotional pricing of $0.375/M input and $1.875/M output.
gist.impact: Paid API users get Gemini 3.7 Flash through existing Gemini model names with consistent Vertex routing, five-minute cache pricing, search support, and unchanged `priceMultiplier: 1` billing.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a careful mail carrier or gardener replacing labels on three familiar glowing seed packets labeled `gemini`, `3.6 flash`, and `3.5 flash`, all feeding into one fresh Gemini 3.7 Flash plant in a cozy terminal garden. A small CRT monitor robot can display a neat provider route sign reading `google-vertex/global`, while five tiny clock-shaped cache jars suggest the five-minute cache window.
